about_the_game:
▶ Demo available now – try it before the November 2025 release!

Old-school action at its core: slaughter your way through hordes, gain levels, upgrade your stats, and repeat to grow stronger for epic boss battles.

DEMO FEATURES:
⚔️ 4 biomes + 1 dungeon, 9 enemy types, 1 boss
🔥 Level up to 20 and unlock a unique skill
🕹️ ~30-45 mins (or more – no level cap!)

FULL VERSION COMING:
🧙 25+ enemies, 3x more zones, Koshchei’s visual evolution
🗡️ New skill branches and phase-based bosses

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (x64)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon HD 5550 / NVIDIA GeForce 9600 GT
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Help Koshchei the Immortal reclaim his power in an old-school action RPG. No fluff. Kill – Level Up – Grow Stronger – Repeat.
